speech.date_context_note: The recording itself does not state a date. Secondary chronology places the earlier Balar Arangam honour on 1971-09-04 and the renovated Kalaivanar Arangam opening on 1974-01-29. The present memorial-day recording is therefore cautiously treated as likely 1974-01-29 or later, but speech.date remains null.
